newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Huandao '96 net rises 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: China's Huandao '96 net rises 25 pct.

text.p: Hainan Huandao Industry Co Ltd, whose biggest shareholder plans to list H shares this year, reported on Thursday that its 1996 net profit had gained 25.27 percent against 1995.
Huandao Industry's 1996 net profit rose to 47.63 million yuan from 38.02 million yuan from the previous year, the company said in an annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
Turnover jumped 33.70 percent to 175.17 million yuan from 131.01 million in 1995, it said.
Per-share net was 0.53 yuan last year, up from 0.24 yuan in 1995, said Huandao Industry, which operates a five-star hotel and entertainment facilities in Haikou, capital of Hainan province.

Huandao Industry, which listed 31 million A shares in Shenzhen on February 28, 1997, said it planned to make an one-for-one bonus issue for 1996, pending the approval by shareholders at a meeting scheduled on May 8.

The company's biggest shareholder China Huandao (Group) Co plans to list in Hong Kong by the end of 1997, Gao Zhenxian, a Huandao Industry spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
